notices.short_title: PRE-SOLICITATION CONFERENCE  BID 2600052 - SKID STEER LOADER  DSNY
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking bids for a skid steer loader for the Department of Sanitation, with bids due April 21, 2026, under a competitive sealed bid process in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: BATTERY ELECTRIC DRY FREIGHT TRUCK WITH LIFTGATE

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration

The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene intends to award a media buyer contract for bus shelter advertising, with responses to a request for information due March 27, 2026.

notices.short_title: SPECIALIZED CLEANING SERVICES AT PATH FACILITY
notices.vendor_name: New York State Industries for the Disabled Inc

notices.short_title: Furnishing and Installing Accessible Pedestrian Signals at Intersections, QNS-R

notices.short_title: PRISM P92 36 INCH GEAR DRIVE COMPUTERIZED PAPER CUTTER
